_readme: The Boundry product directory. Adding an entry here adds the product to the homepage, Ecosystem, Investors, footer and sitemap on the next build. Only 'id', 'name', 'category', 'summary' and 'responsibility' are required. 'url' may be null when a product has no public site. Product accents live in the design foundation (vendor/stack-ui/brand/brand.json), not here. Each product's logo is static/images/products/<id>.png, cropped from the product's own repository; the build fails without it. 'status' must be one of the values in site.json → productStatuses, or null if not yet confirmed for publication. To place a product in the architecture diagram, add its id to site.json → architecture.

products.name: FeltKit
products.summary: Product one: a preassembled application stack that agents can operate, built on FeltDB and AppPort. Go from zero to a deployed application in minutes, with a studio to configure and maintain it, not just develop it.

products.name: FeltDB
products.summary: Durable state for applications and agents: atomic transactions, safe concurrency and reactive collections, with one API from the browser to Managed FeltDB, so application code does not change when the deployment does.

products.name: AppPort
products.summary: Capabilities as contracts: discoverable, governed and reusable across applications, agents and technologies, together with the operational services applications need: files, notifications, configuration, jobs and webhooks.

products.name: AppBoundry
products.summary: Runs portable application artifacts inside a controlled boundary, reaching state and capabilities only through controlled interfaces.

products.name: AuthBoundry
products.summary: Authority and delegation for people and agents: policy evaluation, delegated authority and permission enforcement at system boundaries.
